A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was the '''leader''' of the [[Beray faction|faction]] from [[Beray]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]]. The Sith was the target of failed [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts from both the [[Slippery Hilts|father]] and [[Varner Hilts' mother|mother]] of Sith [[Caretaker]] [[Varner Hilts]].
